newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Philip Morris to build Colombian food plant.
newsitem.headline: Philip Morris to build Colombian food plant.

text.p: Philip Morris announced Tuesday it would set up a $20 million Kraft Foods plant in Cali, Colombia's second largest city.
The Alimentos Kraft de Colombia factory will start operations in October this year and will initially employ 150 people, said Sonia Bozzi, head of corporate affairs for Philip Morris Colombia.
She said the plant would produce powdered beverages to supply markets in Colombia, Ecuador and Venezuela and would import a range of Kraft Foods' mayonnaise, pastas, breakfast cereals and sauces.
Bozzi said the planned powdered beverages line could generate $10 million export earnings for the new plant.
